statutes.act: Read With Section 149 Of The Indian Penal Code

facts: This criminal appeal arises from a special leave petition in which notice was issued solely on the question of sentence.

The Trial Court imposed punishment of rigorous imprisonment for three years alongwith a fine of Rs.12,000/- each for the offence under Section 308/149 and lesser sentences including fines for the remaining offences.

The High Court considered the materials in detail and held the appellants as well as other three co-accused guilty of offence punishable only under Section 325 read with Section 149 of the Indian Penal Code.

Although such relief was granted to those three co-accused mainly on consideration of their old age varying between 85 to 75 years, the appellants claim parity on account of similar role assigned to all the five convicts.
The occurrence is of 1997 and the ordeal of long trial has been faced by the appellants for about 19 years.
petitioner_arguments: The other three co-accused who were convicted for similar offences were ordered by the High Court to be released on probation of good conduct for the term of imprisonment.
The appellants claim parity on account of similar role assigned to all the five convicts.
The appellants have faced an ordeal of long trial for about 19 years.
court_reasoning: The High Court enhanced the sentence from three years to five years RI for the main offence because it was concerned and moved by the suffering of the injured Budhram on account of the sole head injury caused by lathi.

In such a situation, considering the other facts and circumstances, particularly the genesis of the occurrence which was on account of a dispute between the parties over a right to have a drain in a passage, we are persuaded to reduce the period of sentence for the offences under Section 325 read with Section 149 of the IPC in respect of both the appellants from five years to three years RI.
holding: With the aforesaid modification in the sentence of the appellants, the Appeal is disposed of.
